business_summary: Twelve Seas Investment Company III does not have significant operations. It intends to effect a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. Twelve Seas Investment Company III was incorporated in 2024 and is based in Los Angeles, California.
business_summary_ko: Twelve Seas Investment Company III는 중요한 사업을 운영하고 있지 않습니다. 하나 이상의 기업과 합병, 합병, 주식 교환, 자산 취득, 주식 매입, 재편성 또는 유사한 사업 결합을 수행할 계획입니다. Twelve Seas Investment Company III는 2024년에 설립되었으며 캘리포니아주 로스앤젤레스에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
